title: X-LAB RS9 frameset specification
notes: Official mainland RS9 frameset page: the frameset includes a carbon integrated handlebar and carbon seatpost; frame weight 750 g for an unpainted size-M frame excluding fork and seatpost; carbon fork with 12×100 mm thru-axle and flat-mount brakes. The official bicycle listing shows the frameset at CNY 17,800. No maximum tire clearance is stated.
